print('--- scaled to feasible ---')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from checkcert import valid_cut
rng=random.Random(9)
for (nn, gpus, nv, ibn, dem) in [(2,4,30,3,10),(3,4,30,3,5),(4,8,30,25,20),(2,4,30,3,4),(3,4,8,3,7)]:
    n, links = fabric(nn, gpus, nv, ibn)
    m=len(links)
    ps = rng.sample(range(nn*gpus), min(nn*gpus, rng.randint(3,9)))
    demands={v: (dem if rng.random()<0.7 else 0) for v in ps}
    if sum(demands.values())==0: demands[ps[0]]=dem
    base={}
    for l,(u,v,c) in enumerate(links):
        base[l] = nv if (v >= nn*gpus and v < nn*gpus+nn) else ibn
    scale=1
    while True:
        env={l: max(1, r*scale) for l,r in base.items()}
        job=Job(n, links, demands, 1, env)
        cut=find_deficient_cut(job)
        if cut is None: break
        scale*=2
        if scale>10**9: break
    if cut is not None:
        print('never feasible', nn, gpus, dem); continue
    t0=time.monotonic(); plan=compile_plan(job, budget=25); dt=time.monotonic()-t0
    ok = plan is not None and check_plan(job, plan)
    print(f'scaled nn={nn} gpus={gpus} dem={dem} scale={scale} |C|={len(ps)} D={job.D}: ok={ok} time={dt:.2f} trees={len(plan["trees"]) if plan else "-"} routes={len(plan["routes"]) if plan else "-"} recipes={len(plan["recipes"]) if plan else "-"}')
